mentions.name: PodSnacks
mentions.description: PodSnacks delivers personalized AI summaries of top podcast episodes to the user's inbox. Users choose their favorite shows and receive short, high-signal email summaries instead of listening to full audio, with LLM-generated recaps of popular episodes from shows like Lex Fridman, Acquired, All-In, and Invest Like the Best. Upcoming features include bundling by theme, language translations, and audio feeds.
mentions.problem: Keeping up with podcasts across tech, business, and science is overwhelming, with too much audio to skim through and endless backlog guilt.
mentions.audience: People who want more inputs without more noise — those trying to keep up with top podcasts across tech, business, and science without the audio backlog.
